plain_english: Now the initiation giving immediate departure is set forth: from that moment, or from enjoyment, at body's fall one may go to Śiva — so hinted in the Mālinīśāstra by the Great Lord.
sanskrit_cite: atha sadyaḥsamutkrāntipradā dīkṣā nirūpyate tatkṣaṇāccopabhogādvā dehapāte śivaṃ vrajet ityuktyā mālinīśāstre sūcitāsau maheśinā

plain_english: At body's fall, when death is near, from śaktipāta's clearness, having obtained Śāṃkara initiation: hence from the initiation-moment, the supreme.
sanskrit_cite: dehapāte samīpasthe śaktipātasphuṭatvataḥ āsādya śāṃkarīṃ dīkṣāṃ tasmāddīkṣākṣaṇātparam

plain_english: The meaning 'may go to Śiva' was explained here, from prior-posterior discernment, by our venerable guru Śambhunātha.
sanskrit_cite: śivaṃ vrajedityartho@tra pūrvāparavivecanāt vyākhyātaḥ śrīmatāsmākaṃ guruṇā śambhumūrtinā

plain_english: When death is near and śaktipāta arises, there, in mild cases, by guru-service life may go to diminution.
sanskrit_cite: yadā hyāsannamaraṇe śaktipātaḥ prajāyate tatra mande@tha gurvādisevayāyuḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet

plain_english: Or else, through kin-friends-and-the-rest, the Omnipresent's [grace] falls; or before, the samayin has not at all obtained supreme initiation.
sanskrit_cite: athavā bandhumitrādidvārā sāsya vibhoḥ patet pūrvaṃ vā samayī naiva parāṃ dīkṣāmavāptavān

plain_english: Even the initiated, desiring to abandon life-breaths, freed from affliction: the final guru should then perform immediate-departure initiation.
sanskrit_cite: āptadīkṣo@pi vā prāṇāñjihāsuḥ kleśavarjitam antyāngurustadā kuryātsadya+utkrāntidīkṣaṇam

plain_english: But not in immature impurity, nor even in remaining-karmic-body, should departure be performed: so set forth in the venerable Gahvara.
sanskrit_cite: natvapakvamale nāpi śeṣakārmikavigrahe kuryādutkramaṇaṃ śrīmadgahvare ca nirūpitam

plain_english: Having seen the disciple age-seized, oppressed by disease, having made depart, then he should join this one in the supreme principle.
sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭvā śiṣyaṃ jarāgrastaṃ vyādhinā paripīḍitam utkramayya tatastvenaṃ paratattve niyojayet

plain_english: In the qualifier-qualified relation, from desire-conduct-arrangement, the aforesaid things were here set forth by venerable Śambhunātha.
sanskrit_cite: viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatve kāmacāravidhānataḥ pūrvoktamarthajātaṃ śrīśambhunātra nirūpitam

plain_english: Having performed all the aforesaid rite, from samaya-purity, he should place his blazing marma-scissors knife.
sanskrit_cite: vidhiṃ pūrvoditaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā samayaśuddhitaḥ kṣurikāmasya vinyasyejjvalantīṃ marmakartarīm

plain_english: Having performed all the aforesaid nyāsa, equal-to-fire-of-time, by withdrawal-sequence together with the two scissors.
sanskrit_cite: kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ nyāsaṃ kālānalasamaprabham saṃhṛtikramataḥ sārdhaṃ sṛkchindiyugalena tu

plain_english: Having performed fire-natured dhāraṇā, all-marma-scorching: he should fill the body with breath from thumb to head-end.
sanskrit_cite: āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā sarvamarmapratāpanīm pūrayedvāyunā dehamaṅguṣṭhānmastakāntakam

plain_english: Having drawn up from thumb to upper-end, by the to-be-spoken he should cut the marmas from the hole-end, by Kālarātrī dismiss.
sanskrit_cite: tamutkṛṣya tato@ṅguṣṭhādūrdhvāntaṃ vakṣyamāṇayā kṛntenmarmāṇi randhrāntāt kālarātryā visarjayet

plain_english: By this sequential yoga, yoked, libation-abandoned: even the samayin goes to that initiation — thus in the Mālinī doctrine.
sanskrit_cite: anena kramayogena yojito hutivarjitaḥ samayyapyeti tāṃ dīkṣāmiti śrīmālinīmate

plain_english: From sixteen-supports-six-wheels-three-targets-five-ether, or somewhere else, as before the beast-rite.
sanskrit_cite: ṣoḍaśādhāraṣaṭcakralakṣyatrayakhapañcakāt kvacidanyataratrātha prāguktapaśukarmavat

plain_english: Having entered the root from the kanda-region, cutting from non-difference-discernment, by full-oblation use he should join in his own-desired abode.
sanskrit_cite: praviśya mūlaṃ kandādeśchindannaikyavibhāvanāt pūrṇāhutiprayogeṇa sveṣṭe dhāmni niyojayet

plain_english: Knowledge-trident, blazing, radiant-three-wheels-blazing: having meditated by that, his feeling, awakening, whirling.
sanskrit_cite: jñānatriśūlaṃ saṃdīptaṃ dīptacakratrayojjvalam cintayitvāmunā tasya vedanaṃ bodhanaṃ bhramam

plain_english: Inflaming, striking, pricking, moving, again and again from-kanda-wheel-going: he should perform specially in the heart-lotus.
sanskrit_cite: dīpanaṃ tāḍanaṃ todaṃ calanaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ kandādicakragaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa hṛdambuje

plain_english: At the twelve-end, then, having performed, in the bindu-pair he should cast: in the unmarked or supreme abode, joined to the Supreme Lord.
sanskrit_cite: dvādaśānte tataḥ kṛtvā binduyugmagate kṣipet nirlakṣye vā pare dhāmni saṃyuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ

plain_english: Not should he perform any saṃskāra for him: thus says the god in the Gahvara — what of his full one, by śrāddha-and-the-rest considered?
sanskrit_cite: na tasya kuryātsaṃskāraṃ kaṃcidityāha gahvare devaḥ kimasya pūrṇasya śrāddhādyairiti bhāvitaḥ

plain_english: In the venerable Dīkṣottara this rite, fire-put-in: haṃsa, man below his, with Rudra-bindu.
sanskrit_cite: śrīmaddīkṣottare tveṣa vidhirvahnipuṭīkṛtaḥ haṃsaḥ pumānadhastasya rudrabindusamanvitaḥ

plain_english: In the disciple's body joined, this unagitated: a hundred should he mutter; having departed by upward blink, the disciple thus may go supreme.
sanskrit_cite: śiṣyadehe niyojyaitadanudvagnaḥ śataṃ japet utkramyordhvanimeṣeṇa śiṣya itthaṃ paraṃ vrajet

plain_english: This indeed is the rite in the venerable Siddhayogīśvarī doctrine: this departure-initiation to be performed by the yogin's guru.
sanskrit_cite: eṣa eva vidhiḥ śrīmatsiddhayogīśvarīmate iyamutkrāmaṇī dīkṣā kartavyā yogino guroḥ

plain_english: Unpracticed in prāṇa-conduct, how will he perform this? The to-be-spoken Brahma-vidyā, with parts, partless-included.
sanskrit_cite: anabhyastaprāṇacāraḥ kathamenāṃ kariṣyati vakṣyamāṇāṃ brahmavidyāṃ sakalāṃ niṣkalombhitām

plain_english: In his ear, or should read again, again, or then should cause to read; himself and rite should perform, tattva-purity-and-the-rest, the guru.
sanskrit_cite: karṇe@sya vā paṭhedbhūyo bhūyo vāpyatha pāṭhayet svayaṃ ca karma kurvīta tattvaśuddhyādikaṃ guruḥ

plain_english: By mantra-rite-force, full-oblation-thus, he should join to the supreme; without yoga-practice even, immediate-departure-giving, the guru.
sanskrit_cite: mantrakriyābalātpūrṇāhutyetthaṃ yojayetpare yogābhyāsamakṛtvāpi sadya+utkrāntidāṃ guruḥ

plain_english: By knowledge-mantra-rite-meditation-force to perform: should be able; by this is departed the disciple, by force alone, one moment.
sanskrit_cite: jñānamantrakriyādhyānabalātkartuṃ bhavetprabhuḥ anayotkramyate śiṣyo balādevaikakaṃ kṣaṇam

plain_english: Having transgressed time, enjoyment is momentary; what then? Immediate-departure-giving and another, in which full-oblation then.
sanskrit_cite: kālasyollaṅghya bhogo hi kṣaṇiko@syāstu kiṃ tataḥ sadya+utkrāntidā cānyā yasyāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ tadā

plain_english: Should give when his life-breaths would certainly be desiring to depart: even without rite, by forthcoming Brahma-vidyā force, the guru.
sanskrit_cite: dadyādyadāsya prāṇāḥ syurdhruvaṃ niṣkramaṇecchavaḥ vināpi kriyayā bhāvibrahmavidyābalādguruḥ

plain_english: By ear-muttering use, from tattva-armor-net, liberating as desired: in with-parts, in partless, in both.
sanskrit_cite: karṇajāpaprayogeṇa tattvakañcukajālataḥ niḥsārayanyathābhīṣṭe sakale niṣkale dvaye

plain_english: In tattva, wherever, anywhere, he should join the person in sequence: samayin or putraka should read this vidyā, thus.
sanskrit_cite: tattve vā yatra kutrāpi yojayetpudgalaṃ kramāt samayī putrako vāpi paṭhedvidyāmimāṃ tathā

plain_english: From its reading but, samaya-joined attains Rudra-share-arrival: these two in japa and in study, since both authorized.
sanskrit_cite: tatpāṭhāttu samayyuktāṃ rudrāṃśāpattimaśnute etau jape cādhyayane yasmādadhikṛtāvubhau

plain_english: In teaching or instructing, or: he, this study excepted — of these two reading, by its nature his, that course.
sanskrit_cite: nādhyāpanopadeśe vā sa eṣo@dhyayanādṛte paṭhatostvanayorvastusvabhāvāttasya sā gatiḥ

plain_english: As forbidden-beings-and-the-rest actions, mantra remembering himself: even when possessed, somewhere does not go loss, from doership-abandoning.
sanskrit_cite: yathā niṣiddhabhūtādikarmā mantraṃ smaransvayam āviṣṭe@pi kvacinnaiti lopaṃ kartṛtvavarjanāt

plain_english: As, and causing-to-recite scripture, samayin in empty-dwelling: not is lost, from that inner-beings-group-benefiting.
sanskrit_cite: yathā ca vācayañśāstraṃ samayī śūnyaveśmani na lupyate tadantaḥsthaprāṇivargopakārataḥ

plain_english: Thus himself reading this vidyā, from thing-nature: in that released not would be lost, since doing-something-here he.
sanskrit_cite: tathā svayaṃ paṭhanneṣa vidyāṃ vastusvabhāvataḥ tasminmukte na lupyeta yato kiṃcitkaro@tra saḥ

plain_english: Indeed before the uninitiated he should not recite scripture-method.
sanskrit_cite: nanu cādīkṣitāgre sa noccarecchāstrapaddhatim

plain_english: Well, before the wall even his: prohibition but now is told by exception, who to hear to ascertain is capable.
sanskrit_cite: hanta kuḍyāgrato@pyasya niṣedhastvatha kathyate paryudāsena yaḥ śrotumavadhārayituṃ kṣamaḥ

plain_english: He indeed here is forbidden, not walls-insects-birds; then stone-like he, dissolved-sense-activity.
sanskrit_cite: sa evātra niṣiddho no kuḍyakīṭapatatriṇaḥ tarhi pāṣāṇatulyo@sau vilīnendriyavṛttikaḥ

plain_english: Before him, of him reading, prohibition-transgression how? He but, by thing-nature, even dissolved-eyed awakens.
sanskrit_cite: tasyāgre paṭhatastasya niṣedhollaṅghanā katham sa tu vastusvabhāvena galitākṣo@pi budhyate

plain_english: By sense-independence inner consciousness-power, by self-luminous: prior body indeed desiring to abandon not supreme, and established.
sanskrit_cite: akṣānapekṣayaivāntaścicchaktyā svaprakāśayā prāgdehaṃ kila tityakṣurnottaraṃ cādhitaṣṭhivān

plain_english: In the middle, from awakening-force, would awaken the person: mantras, sound-made, by pure-reflection-nature itself.
sanskrit_cite: madhye prabodhakabalāt pratibudhyet pudgalaḥ mantrāḥ śabdamayāḥ śuddhavimarśātmatayā svayam

plain_english: By meaning-self, and shining that meaning-awakening: by that his, of dissolved-eyed, awakening arises itself.
sanskrit_cite: arthātmanā cāvabhāntastadarthapratibodhakāḥ tenāsya galitākṣasya prabodho jāyate svayam

plain_english: From self-consciousness-same-kind-mantra-reflection-proximity: as indeed-small-speed wind, same-kind-mixed.
sanskrit_cite: svacitsamānajātīyamantrāmarśanasaṃnidheḥ yathā hyalpajavo vāyuḥ sajātīyavimiśritaḥ

plain_english: Speedy, so-self: sleeping-reflection even thus awakens; awakened he and born, not and-uninitiated, is called.
sanskrit_cite: javī tathātmā saṃsuptāmarśo@pyevaṃ prabudhyate prabuddhaḥ sa ca saṃjāto na cādīkṣita ucyate

plain_english: Initiation, for, name, saṃskāra: not but-other-is, and-his, for, hence indeed, own scripture reads somewhere in samaya.
sanskrit_cite: dīkṣā hi nāma saṃskāro na tvanyatso@sti cāsya hi ata eva nijaṃ śāstraṃ paṭhati kvāpi sāmaye

plain_english: Having heard that, someone if fortunate is liberated, not his that loss; scripture-censure let not this one do — of two fall-giving.
sanskrit_cite: tacchrutvā ko@pi dhanyaścenmucyate nāsya sā kṣatiḥ śāstranindāṃ maiṣa kārṣīddvayoḥ pātityadāyinīm

plain_english: Thus supreme this, not uninitiated before, should read thus: as and samayin in wood, in clod, or mantra-joining.
sanskrit_cite: ityevaṃparametannādīkṣitāgre paṭhediti yathā ca samayī kāṣṭhe loṣṭe vā mantrayojanām

plain_english: Doing in that flutters thus: not loss, likewise here, for since his proof-arrival-desiring, of samayin thus.
sanskrit_cite: kurvaṃstasmiṃścalatyeti na lopaṃ tadvadatra hi yato@sya pratyayaprāptiprepsoḥ samayinastathā

plain_english: Of one engaged, by nature, in that released: not indeed loss. But the sādhaka always in the to-be-accomplished fruit, from rule-constraint.
sanskrit_cite: pravṛttasya svabhāvena tasminmukte na vai kṣatiḥ sādhakastu sadā sādhye phale niyatiyantraṇāt

plain_english: Even fly-heard mantra: expiation-fitness should perform. Thus immediate-departure is spoken, by that command of the guru.
sanskrit_cite: makṣikāśrutamantro@pi prāyaścittaucitīṃ caret itthaṃ sadyaḥsamutkrāntiryoktā tāmājñayā guroḥ

plain_english: Samayin and the rest even, at the spoken time, for the spoken meaning's accomplishment: himself should perform practiced prāṇa-conduct going-coming.
sanskrit_cite: samayyādirapi proktakāle proktārthasiddhaye svayaṃ kuryātsamabhyastaprāṇacāragamāgamaḥ

plain_english: Unmade-authorized or even the guru, for samaya-purity, in lower-state: but not knowledge-kindled-conscious.
sanskrit_cite: akṛtādhikṛtirvāpi guruḥ samayaśuddhaye adhastanapadāvastho natu jñāneddhacetanaḥ

plain_english: Thus this immediate-departure hinted in Mālinī-doctrine: himself or by the guru or then as to be performed by the Great Lord.
sanskrit_cite: itīyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiḥ sūcitā mālinīmate svayaṃ vā guruṇā vātha kāryatvena maheśinā

plain_english: All enjoyment ugly, but having deemed, body should abandon if: then by that, quickly by sequence, joined, samayin, Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ bhogaṃ virūpaṃ tu matvā dehaṃ tyajedyadi tadā tena krameṇāśu yojitaḥ samayī śivaḥ

plain_english: Spoken this immediate-departure, which to-be-guarded, by the wise like life.
sanskrit_cite: ukteyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiryā gopyā prāṇavadbudhaiḥ
